div.head: Ine 54.1
div.ab: Gif hine man gylt, ðonne mot he gesyllan án þara hyndena gehwylcere monna byrnan ⁊ sweord on ðæt wergild, gif he ðurfe.
Gif hine mon gilt, þonne mot he gesellan on þara hyndenna gehwelcere monnan ⁊ byrnan ⁊ sweord on þæt wergild, gif he ðyrfe.
Si reddatur, tunc licebit dari in illa societate quorumcumque hominum loricam et gladium, si opus sit, in weregildo.
Gif hine mon gilt, þonne mot he gesellan on þara hyndenna gehwelcere monnan ⁊ byrnan ⁊ sweord on þæt wergild, gif he ðyrfe.
If recompense is made for [the slain man], then he may include in each hundred [shillings] a man [=slave] and a byrnie and a sword towards the wergild, if he needs to.
If payment is made for the dead man, then he [the slayer] may, if need be, include a man [i.e. a slave] and a coat of mail, and a sword, in each hundred shillings of the wergeld.

Wenn man diesen entgilt, dann darf man auf dies Wergeld, wenn man [durch Armuth] muss, in jeder der Hundertzahlen [der Schillingsumme des Wergelds je] einen Sklaven und einen Panzer und ein Schwert einzahlen.

If one pays for this man, then one may, if one has to [through poverty], pay into this wergeld in each of the hundreds [of the shilling-sum of the wergeld] a slave and a coat of mail and a sword [each].
